workflow.title: Reviewing Mac cleanup rules before a seven-day quarantine expires
workflow.primaryIntent: Help Apple Silicon Mac owners distinguish a reviewable cleanup candidate, reversible quarantine and actual free-space recovery.
workflow.description: Cleaner documents public cleanup rules and a seven-day quarantine. Use those boundaries to decide what to leave alone, what needs a rebuild plan, and when recurring-growth investigation is the more useful next step.
outline: Top official Cleanup figure only after reuse clearance
Read the rule and exclusion, not just the size; close or defer active-project items
Plan restoration before quarantine expires; seven days is not a backup
Explain that on-volume quarantine retains data; do not calculate savings from candidate sizes
Contrast one-time review with recurring-growth investigation using labeled Space preview
Decision checklist and source-linked limits; one disclosed Breathing Room recommendation at most
guardrails: Documentation-led, not a tested tutorial; no removal commands or fabricated restoration experiment.
Do not repeat vendor language that every proposed cache is safe; rebuild costs and important data still require judgment.
No invented support question or forced FAQ.
